info.name: Battle.net Hearthstone Game Data Card Backs Cards API

params.name: set
params.description: The slug of the set the card belongs to. If you do not supply a value, cards from all sets will be returned.

params.name: class
params.description: The slug of the card's class.

params.name: manaCost
params.description: The mana cost required to play the card. You can include multiple values in a comma-separated list of numeric values.

params.name: attack
params.description: The attack power of the minion or weapon. You can include multiple values in a comma-separated list of numeric values.

params.name: health
params.description: The health of the minion. You can include multiple values in a comma-separated list of numeric values.

params.name: collectible
params.description: Whether a card is collectible. A value of 1 indicates that collectible cards are returned; 0 indicates uncollectible cards. To return all cards, use a value of 0,1.

params.name: rarity
params.description: The rarity of a card. This value must match the rarity slugs found in metadata.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of card (minion, spell, weapon, hero). This value must match the type slugs found in metadata.

params.name: minionType
params.description: The type of minion card (murloc, dragon, beast, etc). This value must match the minion type slugs found in metadata.

params.name: keyword
params.description: A required keyword on the card (battlecry, deathrattle, taunt, etc). This value must match the keyword slugs found in metadata.

params.name: textFilter
params.description: A text string used to filter cards. You must include a locale along with the textFilter parameter.

params.name: gameMode
params.description: A recognized game mode (constructed or battlegrounds).

params.name: page
params.description: A page number.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of results per page. Maximum value is 500; if pageSize is greater than 500 or not specified, it will be set to the maximum allowed value.

params.name: sort
params.description: The field used to sort the results. Valid values include manaCost, attack, health, and name.

params.name: order
params.description: The order in which to sort the results. Valid values are asc or desc.

params.name: locale
params.description: The locale to reflect in localized data.

items.docs: Returns an up-to-date list of all cards matching the search criteria. Input 1 or more search parameters to retrieve a list of cards.

params.name: idOrSlug
params.description: The ID or slug of the card to retrieve.

params.name: gameMode
params.description: A recognized game mode (constructed or battlegrounds).

params.name: locale
params.description: The locale to reflect in localized data.

items.docs: Returns the card with an ID or slug that matches the one you specify.
